countries.intro: Free printable worksheets and online practice aligned to the Common Core State Standards, grade by grade.

subjects.name: Math
subjects.intro: Short lessons, 100 practice questions per skill and printable worksheets with answer keys, aligned to the Common Core State Standards for Mathematics.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: Grade 3 is the year of multiplication and division. Master the facts, then use them for area, rounding and word problems.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: Grade 4 is the year of multi-digit multiplication, long division and fractions. Build fluency with big numbers, then use it for fractions, decimals, measurement and angles.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: Grade 2 builds strong number sense: facts within 20, adding and subtracting within 100 and 1000, place value, money, time and measuring. Short lessons and lots of practice make it stick.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 5
grades.intro: Grade 5 brings fractions and decimals to full strength: add fractions with unlike denominators, multiply and divide fractions and decimals, and find volume. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: Grade 6 is the bridge to algebra: ratios, rates and percents, dividing fractions, negative numbers, expressions and equations, area and surface area, and statistics. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.
